```python
def _refill_from_fifo(self, pifo_id):
    for _ in range(self.refill_batch_size):

        self.queue.remove(removed_element)
        self.pifo_current_sizes[pifo_id] -= removed_element.pkt.length
```

Great, the baseline's eviction order (descending from the tail) corroborates descending.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, sys
cases = [
    (b'', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'not json', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{} {}', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{"runs":[],"runs":[]}', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{"x":NaN}', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{"x":1e999}', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{"x":-1e999}', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{"x":Infinity}', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{"x":-Infinity}', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'\xff', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'\x80\x81', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{"runs":[1,2]} trailing', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'[1,2,3]', None),           # not a runs object (schema-unspecified)
    (b'{"runs":[]}', '{"runs":[]}'),
    (b'  {"runs":[]}  ', '{"runs":[]}'),
    (b'{"runs":[]}\n', '{"runs":[]}'),
    (b'{"a":1,"a":2}', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{"runs":[{"x":1,"x":2}]}', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{"runs":[{"events":[["enqueue",1,1,1,1]],"events":[]},"x"]}', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{"runs":{"a":1}}', None),
    (b'0', None),
    (b'null', None),
    (b'"str"', None),
    (b'{"runs":[]', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
    (b'{"runs":', '{"error":"invalid"}'),
]
allok = True
for data, exp in cases:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/cli.py'],
                       input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
    out = p.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
    ok = (p.returncode == 0) and out == (exp if exp is not None else out)
    status = 'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'
    if not ok: allok = False
    print('%s %-45r -> rc=%d %r' % (status, data[:44], p.returncode, out[:50]))
print('ALL OK' if allok else 'SOME FAILED')
EOF
